text: Men Tagi ɓaawo ɗum toɓɓere ñiiɓunde nden ka rannga heɗɗere woɗeere, refti Men waɗi nden toɓɓere woɗeere wano huyre teewu ƴakkande, Men Tagi huyre nden ƴi'e saɗtuɗe, Men ɓorni ɗen ƴi'e teewu, refti Men fuɗɗi mo Tagu goo sabu wuttugol ruuhu on e makko, e yaltinngol mo faade e ngurndan, Barkii Alla Moƴƴo Taguɗo.
